question: g1_delete_item
answer:
Found it. The backend exposes `DELETE /api/v1/cart/{code}/product/{sku}` — `removeLine` matches the line by the product's **SKU** (a String). But `deleteFromCart` built the URL with `item.id`, the product's numeric ID, so the backend found no matching line and errored. The action's `catch` only logs, so nothing ever happened in the UI.

The fix is a one-line change in [deleteFromCart](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/okf/work/g1_delete_item/okf/codex/4/src/redux/actions/cartActions.js:163): the URL now uses `item.sku`, consistent with how `addToCart` already identifies products.

Files I used:
- [src/redux/actions/cartActions.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/okf/work/g1_delete_item/okf/codex/4/src/redux/actions/cartActions.js) — read and fixed
- [src/util/constant.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/okf/work/g1_delete_item/okf/codex/4/src/util/constant.js) — to resolve the URL fragments
- [src/pages/other/Cart.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/okf/work/g1_delete_item/okf/codex/4/src/pages/other/Cart.js) — to confirm how the item object is passed
- okf guide: `okf/index.md`, `okf/references/backend/routes.md`, the `shoppingCart` endpoint and `shoppingcart` model module docs — to confirm the route expects SKU and that cart items carry `sku`
- [src/util/webService.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/okf/work/g1_delete_item/okf/codex/4/src/util/webService.js) — not read; not needed

/bin/bash -lc 'cat src/util/constant.js; echo ---; ls okf/references/backend; echo ---; rg -l -i "cart" okf/references/backend | head'

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'EOF'
import io
p='src/redux/actions/cartActions.js'
s=open(p).read()
old=\"let action = constant.ACTION.CART + cartID + '/' + constant.ACTION.PRODUCT + item.id + '?store=' + window._env_.APP_MERCHANT;\"
new=\"let action = constant.ACTION.CART + cartID + '/' + constant.ACTION.PRODUCT + item.sku + '?store=' + window._env_.APP_MERCHANT;\"
assert old in s
open(p,'w').write(s.replace(old,new))
print('done')
EOF"
